title: Amazon's Robot Army Is Closing In
hook: The Robots Are Catching Up Fast
source: Amazon company disclosures and public filings, as reported by MIT Technology Review, The Wall Street Journal and Reuters. Warehouse/fulfillment robots deployed approximately 100,000 (2017), 200,000 (2019), 350,000 (2021), 520,000 (2022), 750,000 (2023) and over 1,000,000 (mid-2025, a company-announced milestone). Total Amazon employees worldwide approximately 566,000 (2017), 798,000 (2019), 1,608,000 (2021, the pandemic-hiring peak), 1,541,000 (2022), 1,525,000 (2023) and approximately 1,560,000 (2025), per Amazon's own headcount disclosures compiled by multiple trackers. The robot fleet is growing far faster than the human one.
